sources.title: OSWorld (Xie et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: First scalable real-OS multimodal-agent environment (Ubuntu/Windows/macOS) with task setup, execution-based evaluation, interactive learning; 369 tasks over real web/desktop apps, file I/O, multi-app workflows with per-task setup configs + custom eval scripts; humans 72.36% vs best model 12.24%, failing on GUI grounding and operational knowledge; NeurIPS 2024; code+env open.
claims.context: Full-paper abstract (144KB body, abstract-depth + design consumed).

claims.text: Observation contract: complete desktop screenshot (with mouse position/shape) plus XML-format accessibility tree (ATSPI/PyWinAuto) plus customized streams including terminal outputs; screenshot-only, a11y-only, combined and Set-of-Marks variants compared.
claims.context: Paper §2.3 Observation Space + App A.2 (A.2.1 screenshot, A.2.2 accessibility tree) + §4.1 baseline variants.

claims.text: Action contract: pyautogui mouse/keyboard code actions (moveTo/click/write/press/hotkey/scroll/dragTo/keyDown/keyUp plus WAIT/FAIL/DONE) and the COMPUTER_13 structured action space; syntax-correct code prediction required, composable in program structures.
claims.context: Paper §2.4 Action Space + Table 2 + App A.3 (A.3.1 pyautogui, A.3.2 COMPUTER_13).

limitations.text: Short-horizon scope; long-horizon thesis needs 2.0-side sources.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.finding: Environment design, task construction, and grounding-bottleneck results verified.
Observation/action contract claims verified against bound OSWorld paper §§2.3–2.4 + App A.2/A.3; no DOM/API detail beyond source-accurate structured tool/action interface language.
